You passed the test, but with such a weak score, we\'ll sign you up as a regular leather recruit for now. You\'ll be fetching gear for those who actually know what to do with it… Here, take your new uniform. Too tight? Don\'t worry, it\'s supposed to fit snugly in certain places… Sooner or later, they\'ll teach you everything. But for now, scram!

During the test, we saw your knees shaking. Your answers were pretty shaky, but a result is a result — you can at least bench an empty bar! Here\'s your pass to the dungeon, your new gym bros are already waiting for you in there, they\'ll spot you real good…

You held up honorably. We doubted you for a second, but you proved that you know your stuff about the true culture! One of the scientists bet his ass that you weren\'t one of us… Well, you can guess what happened next! As for you, you\'re free to go.

Some thought it was impossible, but you proved them wrong. You are a true Dungeon Master, a real son of Billy Herrington! A couple of new slaves are already waiting for you outside the door. We hope you can teach them the basics, and we won\'t limit your methods… Welcome!

When we analyzed the results, we were in absolute shock. You need to gain some mass first just to move around without a life support system! So here is your certificate: you are a regular rookie jabroni. The weakest specimen we have ever encountered! You wouldn\'t last a single day in the dungeon, so run along back to mommy.

You tried to hide it, of course, but your weakness exposed itself. You are only good for fetching body oil for the guys when they decide to go wrestling again. So now you are a Gym Slave — take this certificate, show it to your boyfriend, and we\'re getting back to work.

Long story short, the system assigned you to the latex lovers\' camp — people who have never lifted anything heavier than a protein shaker. Sure, you didn\'t show it right away, but we don\'t sit here with multiple degrees working for mere pennies in the name of science for nothing. A single hint is enough for us… Boys, carry him out! Where to? You\'ll show them what you\'re willing to do for 300 bucks!

The scientists argued for a long time, someone even threw a microscope at a colleague, but the decision was made. You are a victim of hardcore fisting! You already know it, maybe you haven\'t accepted it yet, but don\'t worry, you\'re not alone. Though there are no more like you in this lab, so get the hell out of here, go lift some weights, work through your trauma, and come back!

Going so strong only to stumble on the very last question… And I was already about to sign the papers to issue your first leather belt. Good thing the rest of the scientists and I weren\'t born yesterday and know how to spot guys like you. So let\'s just admit you got the wrong door, just like your two new friends waiting right behind you. Have a great time together, boys!

Gotcha, you sneaky bastard! Thought you could cheat the system and simplify the questions to skip the line into the dungeon with the boys? Alas, you were caught, you naughty boy. We\'ll be waiting for your retake, though let\'s be honest, it won\'t help you. Carry him out, men!

You have mastered this life — women fear you, men respect you. We have forwarded your results to the proper authorities. Expect a call soon inviting you to participate in a Gachimuchi sparring match on a brand new Gachi Show. Our congratulations!
SYSTEM BLACKOUT!
Connection to the dungeon lost. The scientists cannot conduct Gachi-experiments offline — they need to analyze your data in real time. Turn on the internet, and we will continue testing you.

Thanks to your contribution, the lab assistants are back in action. Cucumbers have been delivered to all sectors. Please ignore the strange noises coming from the dark corridors — those are just sounds of pure joy.
Welcome to the Middle Ages. You\'re not the king, though. What is your brutal profession in the castle?
Rat catcher
Slave (Spanking boy with a leather belt)
Jester
Chimney sweep in a latex suit
Night gold digger (Cesspool cleaner)
Which vegetable from the list is… to your liking?
Cucumber
Eggplant
Carrot (For rookies)
Pack them all up for me!
Picture this: walking with a girl, and a group of guys blocks your path. The vibes are immaculate…ly bad. What\'s the move?
Mama\'s Little Track Star. Remember PE class and hit a world record speedrun out of there.
Mama\'s Little Crybaby. Start sobbing uncontrollably. If I pee myself, maybe they\'ll be too disgusted to touch me.
Mama\'s Little Saint. Start praying out loud. They wouldn\'t dare interrupt a sacred ritual, so I\'m safe. As for the girl… well, she\'s an independent woman, she\'ll manage!
Mama\'s Little Strategist. Honestly, she\'s cooked anyway, so I\'ll pretend to be her \"producer\". Time to make some money!
Let\'s look at the statistics. What is the total number of guys with whom you have been in close contact under the intimate conditions of… the gym, of course.
I lost count during the intense research phases.
Just a single case
Does manual self-testing count?
Around 6–7 successful experiments.
By the way, how do you feel about regular fitness civils who don\'t respect the great Gachi culture or aren\'t familiar with it?
Positive! Let them run on the treadmills, I used to be like that myself.
Extremely negative. I\'m not even sure their puny lifestyle is legal in the gym.
Neutral. Not everyone is ready to understand the deep philosophy of the dark dungeon.
Picture this: someone offers you 1000$ for a photoshoot in women\'s apparel. You taking it?
For a grand in cash? I\'d sign up for way more … stuff than that.
I sometimes do that for free anyway, so easy money, I guess.
$1000? Where were you earlier? I once agreed for 10 bucks and a can of beer…
Your gym bro is struggling with a heavy bench press. How do you \"spot\" him?
I stand behind him and provide some tactical, close-contact motivation from the chest.
I just scream \"LIGHTWEIGHT BABY\" until his ears bleed.
I\'ll record it on video for his private… premium blog. Exclusive content is king, and people will remember him young.
Scientists are looking for new training methods. Which of these from the list do you consider more effective?
Greco-Roman oil wrestling
Synchronized locker room posing
Professional wrestling (bets starting from 300 bucks)
Speed-fitting of leather belts and harnesses
One second, we need to calibrate our sensors. Want something to drink in the meantime?
Rosé wine
Non-alcoholic beer
After a hardcore fisting, only a refreshing Aperol hits the spot
Lavender raf with coconut milk… with a double scoop of protein!
Listen, why do you think there are no standard answer options in this test at all?
Because the scientists have completely lost their minds.
Because boring tests are for weaklings. The philosophy of the dungeon requires chaos!
Because if I downloaded this, the scientists already figured everything out about me…
All of the above. It\'s a total circus.
Which of these locations fits your vibe best?
A sweaty locker room packed with men
A hookah lounge
A seaside beach surrounded by 3 models
A secret dungeon with no windows, but with good soundproofing
You pull up to meet two friends—a guy and a girl. The bro instantly goes in for a high-five, while the girl is already leaning in for a hug. Who are you locking in with first and what\'s the move?
Bros first, no questions asked.
Forget the handshake, I\'m going in for the hug. My boy needs some love too!
Of course, the guy. You already know what I want from him anyway.
Listen here, scientists, give me some real options! I bench 225 and don\'t look at flexing men, dammit!
Club scenario: a girl approaches you and tries to hit on you. Your response?
\"Sorry, I\'m already taken, and I would never cheat on him.\"
I\'d probably get so awkward I\'d embarrass myself… maybe even soil my pants.
I don\'t do clubs. I prefer vanilla house parties with my besties.
Listen here, scientists, give me some real options! I bench 225 and don\'t look at flexing men, dammit!
Alright, now I\'ll deal with you, puny jabroni. Remember the question about the local crew and your girlfriend? I\'m giving you one more shot, because your previous answer was a total fail.
Mama\'s Little Demolition Man. Go full kamikaze mode: scream at the top of your lungs and pretend you have a detonator in your pocket.
Mama\'s Little Good Boy. Tell them your mom doesn\'t let you talk to strangers. As they go for a walk with her, remind her not to take their candy!

Mama\'s Little Menace. Start a loud, dramatic argument with the girl out of nowhere. If you act completely unhinged and yell at her about ruining your vibes, maybe they\'ll think you\'re a psycho and leave you alone.
What do you think is the very first thought that crosses Van Darkholme\'s mind in the morning?
How should I know?! I\'m not in his leather squad.
I\'m sure it\'s thoughts about a lavender coconut milk raf.
No idea, but most likely about punishing disobedient slaves.
What would your dream girl look like?
I\'ve never really thought about it… As long as she\'s a living, breathing person, I\'m good.
Girls are not my thing. Guys are somehow closer to my spirit, especially in latex, mmm…
Smart, beautiful, rich, and ready to do anything for me. And that\'s just the start—the list of red flags is ten pages long.
Situation: you share a room with a roommate who turned out to be an avid Dungeon Master. He makes a very \"clear\" hint. Your actions?
Once doesn\'t make you a slave…
I\'ll agree, but only if it\'s quick, strictly for training purposes, and nobody finds out.
I\'d say yes. Anything to keep the roommate discount on rent, right?
Fine, but I\'m the one driving. No debate.
Which description do you think fits you best?
I\'m a total gym rat and always in shape. I usually work out in neon-pink compression tights for maximum aerodynamic mobility.
I\'m a social butterfly and always the center of attention. I love gossiping about guys with my girls.
I\'m the \"therapist\" friend. I love hugging and comforting my homies, especially the cute ones.
I\'m not in your leather club, look at yourselves, you smartasses! (Wrong answer, but nice try).
How do you feel about street fighting if your honor is on the line?
I prefer peaceful talks. I just got my nails done yesterday and they\'re literally perfect.
Fights terrify me. Getting beaten up is one thing, but I don\'t want to get \"humiliated\" afterward.
No fights, only wrestling. My grandma once beat me with a stick, and I\'ve been in \"pacifist mode\" ever since.
Fighting is for Neanderthals. I\'ll instantly surrender my wallet, my phone, and my dignity, as long as they don\'t mess up my hair.
Is true friendship possible between a man and a woman?
Sure, I have plenty of girlfriends. We even go shopping together.
I\'ve been a permanent resident of the friendzone my whole life.
I quickly make it clear to girls that my heart belongs only to the gym and my bros.
Do you have straight friends?
No!
Yes, my social circle consists only of those.
Yes, but I constantly call my homies fag… — they probably are anyway.
Yeah. Birds of a feather flock together, you know?
If you weren\'t born human, which animal body would you feel most comfortable in?
A Raccoon (I just love touching things and digging through trash).
A Penguin (I like forming \"same-sex\" pairs and hatching rocks together).
A Giraffe (Up to 90% of our intense social bonding and teamwork is strictly between bros. Look it up!).
A Dolphin (I\'m just very affectionate and I don\'t care about gender).
Step aside, I\'ll take it from here. Now then… Scenario: You\'re stranded on a desert island. You can only pick one survival kit. Which one is it?
A tent, a medkit, and a giant sack of cucumbers (only for eating, obviously).
A lighter, a hunting knife, and bright red lipstick (to look fabulous for the rescue team).
Fresh water, warm clothes, and a nail polish set (in \"Hot Pink\").
A flare gun, a week\'s supply of food, and a floor-length pink evening dress.
Picture the ultimate nightmare: you can never hit the gym with your gym bros again. How do you plan to survive the rest of your life?
Don\'t even say that! I can\'t handle that kind of trauma!
Whatever, so my plan is this: grow a massive beer gut, chug cheap beer, raise kids (adopted, because tren dick hit me years ago), argue with the wife, veg out on the couch, and just chill.
I\'m packing my bags and moving to the deep, dark wilderness. A world without my boys is boring and utterly meaningless.
Oh well, I\'ll just hit a different gym and find myself some new bros.
How emotional are you? Are you a \"cry me a river\" type of guy?
I cry every single day. Life is just too cruel to a sensitive soul like mine.
I\'m a total wreck. I start sobbing during the opening credits of \"Hachiko\".
I cried out every last tear in the first 15 years of my life — it\'s kinda tough for guys like me in this country.
You enter the gym: on the left, a fit girl is squatting; on the right, a massive bodybuilder is doing the same. Where does your gaze go first?
The girl. I need to know where she got those stylish leggings.
The guy. Those glutes are a literal work of art.
The guy. That\'s my gym bro! Time for a tactical, high-energy morale boost slap.
The girl. She\'s my coach, I need to say hello before the workout.
How often do you and your gym bro discuss Gachi philosophy?
I don\'t have a gym bro. I joke with the mirror in the locker room, but I think even it started ignoring me…
Jokes became reality. First we were just discussing \"Deep Dark Fantasies\", and now we share a dungeon together.
Constantly. We\'re like preachers — spreading the great teachings of Billy Herrington (meaning yours) to the masses.
We don\'t discuss it. But lately we\'ve been doing oil wrestling to find out who\'s the Boss of this gym.
How do you feel about your body hair?
I shave everything! I can\'t stand being hairy.
I don\'t grow hair at all. Had a full-body laser removal ages ago.
I\'m naturally smooth, just like both of my dads.
I think shaving is a sin, so I basically look like Chewbacca\'s cousin.
Situation: you walk into the locker room, and your gym bro is watching classic videos of tough bodybuilders in leather harnesses while making weird noises. Your actions?
I\'ll lend him a helping hand… and a bottle of body oil.
What a shame! He was a real homie, now he\'s gone for me.
I asked my Dungeon Master NOT to upload our sparring sessions online!
Here we go again… He always starts watching exclusive content without me!
And the last question: so, how did you like our brutal research?
The scientist authors are completely nuts! Refund my 300 bucks for admission right now.
Thanks for the test! Learned a lot of new things about myself, but I still don\'t really feel like hitting the gym.
To hell with the test… I think I\'m finally ready to become the true Boss of this gym!
